shutdown_rule: Graceful stop only; never kill MTPLX. Stop takes about 30 seconds and saves conversation state.
scheduling_note: MTPLX serves one request at a time; judge calls wait behind an agent request.
remaining_prerequisite: #1954 shared sandbox and a quiet window outside its runs
